description_uz: ABS, gibrid motor va energiyani qayta ishlatish haqida maqola asosidagi 4 savol.
description_en: Four article-based questions about ABS, hybrid power and recovering energy.

questions.question_uz: Haydovchi keskin tormoz berganda ABS tizimining asosiy vazifasi nima?
questions.question_en: What is the main job of ABS when a driver brakes hard?
options_en: Preventing the wheels from locking
Increasing engine power during acceleration
Increasing the air pressure in the tyres
Pushing the car harder against the road in a corner
questions.explanation_uz: ABS tormozlash paytida g‘ildiraklarning qulflanishini cheklaydi. Bu haydovchiga boshqaruvni saqlashga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: ABS limits wheel locking during braking. This helps the driver retain steering control.

evidence.quote: ABS — bu tormoz berilganda g‘ildiraklarning to‘liq qulflanib sirpanib ketishini oldini oladigan tizim.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the safety purpose of anti-lock braking.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada tasvirlangan gibrid quvvat tizimi qaysi ikki turdagi motorni birlashtiradi?
questions.question_en: Which two types of motor does the hybrid power system described in the article combine?
options_uz: Yonilg‘ida ishlaydigan motor va elektr motorini
options_en: A petrol engine and a diesel engine
Two petrol engines of different sizes
A fuel-burning engine and an electric motor
Two electric motors of different power ratings
questions.explanation_uz: Gibrid tizimda benzinli yoki dizelli dvigatel elektr motori bilan birga ishlaydi. Maqolada bu uyg‘unlik yoqilg‘ini tejashga yordam berishi tushuntirilgan.
questions.explanation_en: In this hybrid system, a petrol or diesel engine works alongside an electric motor. The article explains how this combination can help save fuel.

evidence.quote: biri benzinli yoki dizelli, ikkinchisi esa elektr bilan ishlaydigan motor.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise the two power sources in the described hybrid system.

questions.question_uz: Jamoa tormozlashda yo‘qoladigan energiyaning bir qismini keyinroq ishlatmoqchi. Maqoladagi qaysi tizim shu maqsadga xizmat qiladi?
questions.question_en: A team wants to use some of the energy lost during braking later on. Which system in the article serves this purpose?
options_en: Anti-lock braking system (ABS)
Energy recovery system (ERS)
Traction control system (TCS)
A crumple zone
questions.explanation_uz: ERS harakat paytida yo‘qolishi mumkin bo‘lgan energiyani yig‘ib, qayta ishlatishga yordam beradi. ABS esa tormozlashdagi g‘ildirak qulflanishini boshqaradi.
questions.explanation_en: ERS helps collect energy that could otherwise be lost and makes it available for reuse. ABS instead manages wheel locking during braking.

evidence.quote: Energiya qayta ishlash tizmi (ERS) - avtomobil harakati paytida issiqlik va tormozdagi energiyani yo‘qotmasdan, uni qayta to‘plab, qayta foydalanish imkoniyatini taqdim etadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Choose energy recovery for a simple reuse scenario.

questions.question_uz: Turbokompressor motor hajmini kattalashtirmasdan quvvatni oshirishga qanday yordam beradi?
questions.question_en: How does a turbocharger help increase power without increasing engine size?
options_en: It injects fuel at high pressure
It controls when the engine valves open
It reduces harmful substances in the exhaust gases
It compresses the air supplied to the engine
questions.explanation_uz: Turbokompressor havo bosimini oshirib, motorga ko‘proq havo kirishiga yordam beradi. Maqola buni motorni hajman kattalashtirmasdan kuchaytirish usuli sifatida tushuntiradi.
questions.explanation_en: A turbocharger increases air pressure to help supply more air to the engine. The article presents this as a way to increase power without enlarging the engine.

evidence.quote: Ular havo bosimi orqali motorni hajmini kattalashtiirb yubormagan holda yana kuchliroq qilish uchun foydalaniladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain the basic purpose of a turbocharger.

title_en: Can you tell race formats apart?
description_uz: Formula E, ralli va karting haqidagi asosiy g‘oyalarni 4 savolda eslang.
description_en: Recall the key ideas about Formula E, rallying and karting in four questions.

questions.question_uz: Maqolaga ko‘ra, qaysi formula poygasidagi avtomobillar faqat elektr bilan harakatlanadi?
questions.question_en: According to the article, which formula racing series uses fully electric cars?
options_en: Formula 1
Formula E
Formula 2
Formula 3
questions.explanation_uz: Formula E elektr quvvati bilan harakatlanadigan avtomobillar poygasidir. Bu uni maqoladagi boshqa formula yo‘nalishlaridan ajratib turadi.
questions.explanation_en: Formula E is a racing series for electrically powered cars. This distinguishes it from the other formula categories in the article.

evidence.quote: Formula E – faqat elektr orqali harakatlanadigan poyga turi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify electric-powered formula racing.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada tasvirlangan ralli bosqichida avtomobillar birma-bir yo‘lga chiqadi. Natijani belgilashda asosiy mezon nima?
questions.question_en: In the rally stage described in the article, cars set off one at a time. What is the main measure used to compare their results?
options_uz: Bir vaqtda nechta mashinani quvib o‘tgani
options_en: How many cars they overtake at the same time
The style score awarded for sliding through corners
The order of cars at the start
The time taken to complete the route
questions.explanation_uz: Rallida ekipajlar bosqichni imkon qadar qisqa vaqtda bosib o‘tishga intiladi. Shuning uchun maqolada ularning raqibi vaqt deb ta’riflangan.
questions.explanation_en: Rally crews aim to complete a stage in the shortest possible time. That is why the article describes time as their opponent.

evidence.quote: Ularning raqibi - bu vaqt.
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish timed rally competition from simultaneous circuit racing.

questions.question_uz: Ralli bosqichida haydovchi mashinani boshqarayotganda shturmanning asosiy vazifasi nima?
questions.question_en: During a rally stage, what is the co-driver’s main job while the driver controls the car?
options_uz: Oldindagi yo‘l va burilishlar haqida aytib turish
Bosqichlar orasida avtomobilga texnik xizmat ko‘rsatish
Raqib ekipajlarning qoidalarga rioya qilishini baholash
options_en: Giving information about the road and turns ahead
Coordinating the plan for stops in the service area
Servicing the car between stages
Judging whether other crews comply with the rules
questions.explanation_uz: Shturman oldindagi yo‘l haqida ma’lumot beradi, haydovchi esa avtomobilni boshqaradi. Bu vazifalar taqsimoti rallida hamkorlikning muhimligini ko‘rsatadi.
questions.explanation_en: The co-driver gives information about the road ahead while the driver controls the car. This division of roles shows why teamwork matters in rallying.

evidence.quote: ularning biri mashinani boshqarsa, narigisi oldinda turgan yo’l haqida ogohlantirib turadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise the co-driver’s role in rally teamwork.

questions.question_uz: Yosh poygachi tez qaror qabul qilish va gaz-tormozni vaqtida qo‘llashni mashq qilmoqchi. Maqolaga ko‘ra, karting unga nimasi bilan foydali?
questions.question_en: A young racer wants to practise quick decisions and well-timed acceleration and braking. According to the article, how can karting help?
options_uz: Poygadagi boshqaruv va strategik fikrlashni rivojlantiradi
Uzoq masofali poyga uchun yoqilg‘i rejasini tuzishni o‘rgatadi
options_en: It teaches aerodynamic tuning in a wind tunnel
It teaches assembly of large racing engines
It develops racing control and strategic thinking
It teaches fuel planning for endurance racing
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada karting gaz va tormozni vaqtida ishlatish, quvib o‘tish va tezkor qarorlar bilan bog‘langan. Bu uni asosiy poyga ko‘nikmalarini rivojlantirish uchun foydali boshlanish qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: The article links karting with well-timed acceleration and braking, overtaking and quick decisions. This makes it a useful starting point for developing basic racing skills.

evidence.quote: tezkor qaror qabul qilish, strategik fikrlashni rivojlanishga yordam beradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Connect karting with foundational driving and decision skills.

title_en: Which material does a racing car need?
description_uz: Titan, alyuminiy, elastomer va karbon kompozitning vazifalarini tekshiring.
description_en: Explore what titanium, aluminium, elastomers and carbon composites do.

questions.question_uz: Formula 1 avtomobilidagi titandan yasalgan halo qaysi vazifani bajaradi?
questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the titanium halo on a Formula 1 car?
options_en: Helping to cool the engine
Increasing the grip of the rear tyres
Protecting the driver’s head
Delivering fuel to the engine
questions.explanation_uz: Halo haydovchining bosh qismini himoya qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan. Maqolada u uchib kelgan jismlar va ag‘darilish xavfi bilan bog‘liq himoya vositasi sifatida tasvirlangan.
questions.explanation_en: The halo is designed to protect the driver’s head. The article describes its protection against flying objects and risks during a rollover.

evidence.quote: mashina ag’darilib ketgan vaqtida haydovchining bosh qismiga zarar yetishligini oldini olish uchun ishlatilinadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Match the halo to its safety function.

questions.question_uz: Muhandis radiator uchun material tanlayapti. Alyuminiyning maqolada aytilgan qaysi xususiyati bu tanlovga yordam beradi?
questions.question_en: An engineer is choosing a material for a radiator. Which property of aluminium mentioned in the article supports this choice?
options_en: It conducts heat well
It strongly insulates against heat
It has very high density
It is elastic like rubber
questions.explanation_uz: Radiator issiqlik almashinuvida qatnashadi. Alyuminiyning yaxshi issiqlik o‘tkazuvchanligi uning bu tizimda ishlatilish sabablaridan biridir.
questions.explanation_en: A radiator takes part in heat transfer. Aluminium’s good thermal conductivity is one reason it is used in this system.

evidence.quote: aluminium juda ham zo’r termal o’tkazuvchanligi hisobiga sovutish tizimidagi radiatorlarda ham uchratishimiz mumkin.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply thermal conductivity to a radiator material choice.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada shinalarda ishlatiladigan elastomerlar qanday material sifatida ta’riflangan?
questions.question_en: How does the article describe the elastomers used in tyres?
options_en: A heat-conducting metal alloy
A hard and brittle glass material
A high-density ceramic material
An elastic and strong polymer material
questions.explanation_uz: Elastomerlar elastik polimerlardir. Maqola ularning egiluvchanligi va bardoshliligini shinalarning ishlashi bilan bog‘laydi.
questions.explanation_en: Elastomers are elastic polymers. The article connects their flexibility and durability with the way tyres perform.

evidence.quote: Bu yuqori darajada elastik, mustahkam va haroratga chidamli polimer material hisoblanadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify elastomers as flexible polymer materials.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada karbon tolalaridan kompozit hosil qilish uchun tolalar nima bilan birlashtiriladi?
questions.question_en: In the article, what is combined with carbon fibres to make a composite?
options_en: Titanium powder
Epoxy resin
A layer of rubber
Ceramic particles
questions.explanation_uz: Karbon tolalari epoksiy smola bilan birlashtirilib kompozit material hosil qilinadi. Bu yerda tolalar va ularni bog‘lovchi modda bir material tarkibida ishlaydi.
questions.explanation_en: Carbon fibres are combined with epoxy resin to form a composite. The fibres and the material binding them work together in one material.

evidence.quote: Keyinchalik bu tolalar epoksiy smola (4.2-rasm)  bilan birlashtiriladi va kompozit material hosil bo‘ladi
evidence.learning_objective: Explain the fibre-and-resin composition of a carbon composite.

source_title: Motorsportda Karyera Yo‘li (1-qism): Dunyo Miqyosidagi Cheksiz Imkoniyatlar
title_en: First steps towards a future in motorsport
description_uz: Maslahat olish, amaliyot va jamoada o‘rganish haqidagi maqolani 4 vaziyatda qo‘llang.
description_en: Apply the article’s advice on mentorship, practical experience and teamwork in four situations.

questions.question_uz: Maktab o‘quvchisi motorsportga qiziqadi va nimadan boshlashni bilmaydi. Maqoladagi tavsiyaga qaysi qadam mos?
questions.question_en: A school student is interested in motorsport and is unsure where to start. Which step matches the article’s advice?
options_uz: Sohadagi odamlardan maslahat so‘rashni universitet tugaguncha kutish
Kasb tanlashda mashhur poygachilarning yo‘lini aynan takrorlash
Faqat baholarga e’tibor berib, amaliy qiziqishlarni keyinga qoldirish
Sohadagi mutaxassisdan maslahat olib, o‘qish va mashg‘ulotlarini rejalash
options_en: Waiting until after university to ask people in the industry for advice
Choosing a career by following famous drivers’ paths exactly
Focusing only on grades and postponing practical interests
Asking a professional for advice and planning study and activities
questions.explanation_uz: Maqola maktab yoshidayoq sohadagi mutaxassislardan maslahat olishni tavsiya qiladi. Bunday maslahat o‘qish va bo‘sh vaqtni maqsadga mos yo‘naltirishga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: The article recommends seeking advice from professionals while still at school. Their advice can help students direct their study and free time towards their interests.

evidence.quote: Shu sohada allaqachon ishlayotgan mutaxassislardan maslahat olishga harakat qiling.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply early career exploration advice to a school student.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada shogirdlikning asosiy afzalligi sifatida nima ko‘rsatilgan?
questions.question_en: What does the article highlight as a main advantage of an apprenticeship?
options_uz: Bitta mavzuda ilmiy dissertatsiya yozishga yo‘naltirilishi
Ish jarayonida amaliy ko‘nikma va tajriba orttirish
Ko‘proq umumiy nazariy fanlarni auditoriyada o‘rganish
options_en: Focusing on writing a research thesis on one topic
Building practical skills and experience through work
Studying more general theoretical subjects in a classroom
Providing specialist preparation for a racing licence test
questions.explanation_uz: Shogirdlik amaliy ish orqali ko‘nikma hosil qilishga yordam beradi. Maqolada avtomobilni yaratish, sozlash va unga xizmat ko‘rsatish bunga misol qilingan.
questions.explanation_en: An apprenticeship helps develop skills through practical work. The article gives building, adjusting and servicing a car as examples.

evidence.quote: poyga avtomobilini yaratish, texnik xizmat ko‘rsatish, sozlash va ishonchliligini ta’minlash ko'nikmalari shakllangan bo‘ladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise the practical learning value of an apprenticeship.

questions.question_uz: Yosh mutaxassis mashhur jamoaga kira olmadi, lekin kichik yetkazib beruvchi kompaniyada amaliyot topdi. Maqola bu imkoniyatni qanday baholaydi?
questions.question_en: A young specialist cannot join a famous team but finds an internship with a small supplier. How does the article view this opportunity?
options_uz: Tajribaning qiymatini avvalo kompaniyaning mashhurligi belgilaydi
Bunday amaliyot katta jamoada ishlagandan keyingina foyda beradi
Turli vazifalarni o‘rganib, tegishli tajriba olish imkonidir
Yetkazib beruvchidagi ish motorsportga tegishli ko‘nikma bermaydi
options_en: The value of the experience is determined mainly by how famous the company is
This internship becomes useful only after working for a large team
It is a chance to learn varied tasks and gain relevant experience
Work at a supplier does not develop skills relevant to motorsport
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada kichik biznes va sohaga xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi kompaniyalar ham o‘rganish uchun yaxshi joy bo‘lishi aytilgan. Muhimi, kompaniya nomidan tashqari olinadigan tajribaga ham qarashdir.
questions.explanation_en: The article says small businesses and suppliers to the industry can also be good places to learn. The experience available matters alongside the company’s name.

evidence.quote: Kichik bizneslarda esa siz ko‘proq mayda-chuyda narsalarga aralashishga majbur bo‘lasiz — bu hatto afzallik ham bo‘lishi mumkin.
evidence.learning_objective: Value relevant experience beyond famous employers.

questions.question_uz: Formula Student jamoasiga qo‘shilgan talaba loyihadan ko‘proq bilim olish uchun nima qilishi kerak?
questions.question_en: What should a student who joins a Formula Student team do to learn more from the project?
options_uz: Faol qatnashib, qarorlar nima uchun qabul qilinishini tushunishi
Jamoa ro‘yxatida ismi turishi bilan kifoyalanishi
Texnik vazifalarni doimo boshqa a’zolarga qoldirishi
Faqat yakuniy natijani ko‘rib, jarayonni o‘tkazib yuborishi
options_en: Take an active role and understand why decisions are made
Be satisfied with having their name on the team list
Always leave technical tasks to other members
Look only at the final result and skip the process
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada jamoaga a’zo bo‘lishning o‘zi yetarli emasligi ta’kidlangan. O‘rganish uchun faol qatnashish va bajarilayotgan ishning sababini tushunish zarur.
questions.explanation_en: The article stresses that team membership alone is not enough. Learning requires active participation and understanding the reasons behind the work.

evidence.quote: siz albatta faol qatnashib, nima qilayotganingiz va nima uchun qilayotganingizni chuqur tushunishingiz kerak.
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish active project learning from nominal participation.

source_title: Kelajakni tezlashtirish: Oʻzbekiston motorsport inqilobi yangi bosqichga ko‘tarilmoqda
title_en: A route into motorsport in Uzbekistan
description_uz: NAFKU haqidagi maqola asosida boshlang‘ich imkoniyatlar va infratuzilmani o‘rganing.
description_en: Explore entry points and infrastructure through the article about NAFKU.

questions.question_uz: NAFKU maqolada qaysi asosiy vazifa bilan tanishtiriladi?
questions.question_en: What main purpose is NAFKU introduced with in the article?
options_uz: Avtosportni rivojlantirish va xalqaro darajaga olib chiqish
Yangi yo‘l avtomobillarini zavodda ishlab chiqarish
options_en: Developing motorsport and supporting its international growth
Planning city bus routes
Manufacturing new road cars in a factory
Setting the sale prices of all cars
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada NAFKU avtosportni rivojlantirish, xalqaro musobaqalar va imkoniyatlarni kengaytirish bilan bog‘langan. Bu vazifa poyga ekotizimini shakllantirishga qaratilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The article connects NAFKU with developing motorsport and expanding international events and opportunities. Its role is described in terms of building the racing ecosystem.

evidence.quote: avtosportni rivojlantirish va xalqaro darajaga ko’tarish
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise the federation’s role as described in the article.

questions.question_uz: Tajribasi kam yosh poygaga qiziqib qoldi. Maqola qaysi yo‘nalishni boshlang‘ich nuqta sifatida tavsiya qiladi?
questions.question_en: A young beginner becomes interested in racing. Which discipline does the article recommend as a starting point?
options_en: Formula 1
Long-distance rally raid
High-powered GT racing
Karting
questions.explanation_uz: Maqola kartingni yangi boshlovchilar uchun tavsiya etilgan kirish nuqtasi sifatida ko‘rsatadi. Uni professional poyga ko‘nikmalari uchun poydevor deb ta’riflaydi.
questions.explanation_en: The article presents karting as a recommended entry point for beginners. It describes it as a foundation for professional racing skills.

evidence.quote: Karting — bu yangi boshlovchilar uchun eng ko’p tavsiya etiladigan va birinchi nuqta bo‘lib
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the recommended entry point for a beginner.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada xalqaro musobaqalarga intilayotgan yoshlar uchun qanday yordam aytilgan?
questions.question_en: What support does the article describe for young people aiming at international competition?
options_uz: Xalqaro litsenziya o‘rniga oddiy haydovchilik guvohnomasini berish
FIA sinovlari o‘rniga jamoaning ichki suhbatini tashkil etish
Xalqaro litsenziya va FIA sinovlariga tayyorlanishda yordam
Poygachi litsenziyasi o‘rniga texniklar sertifikatini olishda yordam
options_en: Providing an ordinary driving licence instead of an international racing licence
Arranging an internal team interview instead of FIA tests
Help with international licensing and preparation for FIA tests
Help obtaining a technician’s certificate instead of a racing licence
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada NAFKU xalqaro litsenziya olish va kerakli sinovlarga tayyorlanishda yordam berishi aytilgan. Bu yordam yoshlarning xalqaro musobaqalar sari tayyorgarligini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.
questions.explanation_en: The article says NAFKU helps with international licensing and preparation for the required tests. This supports young racers as they prepare for international competition.

evidence.quote: NAFKU yosh poygachilarga xalqaro litsenziya olishga, ular uchun zarur bo’lgan FIA test sinovlariga tayyorlanishga yordam beradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the international licensing support described in the article.

questions.question_uz: Nega maqolada doimiy, ko‘p funksiyali poyga majmuasi qurish muhim deb ko‘rsatilgan?
questions.question_en: Why does the article present a permanent, multi-purpose racing complex as important?
options_uz: Avtosavdo va avtomobil ko‘rgazmalari uchun markaz yaratishi sababli
Turli poygalar, sportchilar tayyorgarligi va xalqaro tadbirlarga zamin yaratishi sababli
Musobaqalarni doim yopilgan shahar ko‘chalarida o‘tkazishga yordam berishi sababli
Asosan umumiy yo‘l transporti haydovchilarini tayyorlashga xizmat qilishi sababli
options_en: Because it would create a centre for vehicle sales and car exhibitions
Because it would support several race formats, training and international events
Because it would help run races permanently on closed city streets
Because it would mainly train drivers for ordinary road transport
questions.explanation_uz: Maqoladagi majmua rejasi ralli, drift, gymkhana va karting kabi yo‘nalishlarni qamrab oladi. U tayyorgarlik, musobaqalar va sport turizmi uchun infratuzilma sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The proposed complex in the article covers disciplines such as rally, drift, gymkhana and karting. It is presented as infrastructure for training, competition and sports tourism.

evidence.quote: ralli, drift, gymkhana va karting musobaqalari o’tkazishga imkon beradigan ulkan majmua barpo qilishdir.
evidence.learning_objective: Connect permanent facilities with training and competition opportunities.

source_title: Poyga mashinasi asosiy qismlari — xavfsizlik va harakatlanish uchun zarur bo‘lgan qismlar hamda ularning dizayni
title_en: How does a racing car work?
description_uz: Shassi, motor, aerodinamika va telemetriya vazifalarini 4 savolda tekshiring.
description_en: Check the roles of the chassis, engine, aerodynamics and telemetry in four questions.

questions.question_uz: Poyga avtomobilining shassisi qanday asosiy vazifani bajaradi?
questions.question_en: What is the main role of a racing car’s chassis?
options_uz: Dvigateldagi havo va yonilg‘i aralashmasini boshqaradi
Asosiy qismlarni birlashtiradigan mustahkam tuzilma bo‘lib xizmat qiladi
options_en: It controls the engine’s air and fuel mixture
It provides a strong structure that brings the main components together
It wirelessly sends sensor readings to the team
It compresses air and supplies it to the engine
questions.explanation_uz: Shassi avtomobilning asosiy qismlarini bir butun tuzilmaga birlashtiradi. Maqolada uning qattiqligi, yengilligi va barqarorlikka hissasi tushuntirilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The chassis brings the car’s main parts together in one structure. The article explains the importance of its stiffness, low mass and contribution to stability.

evidence.quote: Shassi(1.1-rasm) mashinaning barcha qismlarini bir butun holda jamlab
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise the chassis as the car’s supporting structure.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada tasvirlangan yonilg‘ili motor energiyani qanday o‘zgartiradi?
questions.question_en: How does the fuel-powered engine described in the article transform energy?
options_en: Mechanical energy into chemical energy in fuel
Electrical energy into light only
Chemical energy in fuel into mechanical work
Sound energy into electrical energy
questions.explanation_uz: Yonilg‘ili motor yonilg‘ida saqlangan kimyoviy energiyadan mexanik ish hosil qilish uchun foydalanadi. Maqola uni avtomobilning harakatlantiruvchi qismlaridan biri sifatida tasvirlaydi.
questions.explanation_en: A fuel-powered engine uses chemical energy stored in fuel to produce mechanical work. The article describes it as a key part of the car’s propulsion.

evidence.quote: yonilg‘idagi kimyoviy energiyani mexanik kuchga aylantiradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the energy transformation in a fuel-powered engine.

questions.question_uz: Muhandis burilishda shinalarning yo‘lga yaxshiroq yopishishini xohlaydi. Aerodinamik pastga bosuvchi kuch bunga qanday yordam beradi?
questions.question_en: An engineer wants the tyres to grip the road better in a corner. How does aerodynamic downforce help?
options_uz: Burilishda barcha g‘ildiraklarni bir xil tezlikda aylantiradi
Yonilg‘i qo‘shish orqali avtomobil massasini oshiradi
options_en: It presses the car more firmly against the road
It lifts the car away from the road
It makes every wheel rotate at the same speed in a corner
It increases the car’s mass by adding fuel
questions.explanation_uz: Pastga bosuvchi aerodinamik kuch shinalarning yo‘l bilan yopishishini yaxshilashga yordam beradi. Buning uchun avtomobilga qo‘shimcha yuk qo‘yish shart emas.
questions.explanation_en: Aerodynamic downforce helps improve tyre grip by pressing the car against the road. It does this without requiring extra ballast.

evidence.quote: Bu kuch avtomobilni yo‘l sirtiga bosib, shinalarning yopishishini va burilish tezligini oshiradi
evidence.learning_objective: Apply the purpose of downforce to cornering grip.

questions.question_uz: Pit jamoasi poyga davomida avtomobil parametrlarini kuzatmoqchi. Maqoladagi qaysi tizim ularga real vaqtda ma’lumot yetkazadi?
questions.question_en: The pit team wants to monitor the car’s parameters during a race. Which system in the article sends them real-time data?
options_en: The chassis
The diffuser
The survival cell
Telemetry
questions.explanation_uz: Telemetriya avtomobil parametrlarini jamoaga uzatadi. Bu ma’lumot diagnostika, sozlash va poyga strategiyasini tanlashga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Telemetry sends the car’s parameters to the team. These data help with diagnosis, adjustments and race strategy.

evidence.quote: yuzlab parametrlar boʻyicha real vaqtdagi maʼlumotlarni pit-uolga
evidence.learning_objective: Choose telemetry for remote, real-time vehicle monitoring.
